# Chronos zero-shot (generated by scripts/run_chronos.py)

Rules fixed in `results/chronos/PREREGISTRATION.md` (commit `9122d6d`) before scoring. Parameters: mini 20,456,192, small 46,154,240. Point forecast = median of 20 samples; context ≤ 512 rows, not crossing the 404-day gap. Mean ± sample std over sampling seeds 1–3. DM vs persistence (HLN, Newey–West lag h − 1); p for seeds 1/2/3 with sign (− = lower loss than persistence). Verdict: sign agrees and p < 0.05 in all three seeds.

Reference rows: best (lowest seed-mean test MASE) validation-selected Phase 3 configuration, and persistence.
